description: Application-owned components composed with Kerf UI.

entries.name: FilterChip
entries.purpose: A removable application filter displayed inside a token-search workflow.
useWhen: A saved application filter needs a compact visible label and remove action.
avoidWhen: The value belongs to TokenSearchField's own controlled token collection.

entries.name: Inspector
entries.purpose: An application inspector composed from Kerf panel, content, and value primitives.
useWhen: A selected record needs a titled fact-and-action region.
avoidWhen: A ValueTable alone expresses the complete interaction.

notes: The embedding pane positions the inspector; PanelHeader, ValueTable, and action groups retain their own geometry.
